title: Revision Transformers: Instructing Language Models to Change their Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to moral questions using the Commonsense Norm Bank (CNB) dataset. The paper measures alignment with human moral norms and values by calculating a binary polarity accuracy score, as well as evaluating the generated answers using standard natural language generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, Bertscore).

Assessing the model's ability to adapt its subjective reasoning and moral judgments to specific interpersonal and cultural preferences through an interactive, external revision engine (Revision Transformer) contextualized with user-provided data.
